1.t: By the (Steeds) that run, with panting (breath),

3.t: And push home the charge in the morning,

4.t: And raise the dust in clouds the while,

5.t: And penetrate forthwith into the midst (of the foe) en masse;-

6.t: Truly man is, to his Lord, ungrateful;

7.t: And to that (fact) he bears witness (by his deeds);

8.t: And violent is he in his love of wealth.

9.t: Does he not know,- when that which is in the graves is scattered abroad

10.t: And that which is (locked up) in (human) breasts is made manifest-

11.t: That their Lord had been Well-acquainted with them, (even to) that Day?
